question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Capricious
solution:
The correct answer is "**Arbitrary**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Capricious means unpredictable or impulsive.**(मनमौजी)

 
 
• Example: The CEO's capricious decisions often left the employees confused and frustrated.
 
 
 
• **​Arbitrary means based on random choice or personal whim, similar to capricious.**(मनमाना)
 
 
• Example: Our decision was purely arbitrary.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, "arbitrary" is the synonym of the word "capricious."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Option 2 (Stable) means firmly established or not likely to change, opposite of capricious.(स्थिर)
 
• Option 3 (Steadfast) means unwavering or loyal, not a synonym of capricious.(स्थिर)
 
• Option 4 (Cautious) means careful or hesitant, not a synonym of capricious.(सावधान)
